typography.font_head: font-head (Display, tight tracking, used for large metrics and dashboard titles)
typography.font_mono: font-mono (Data, numbers, tables, uppercase labels, FAIR quantifications)
typography.rules: Headings: text-white tracking-tight font-light or font-black (avoid generic bold). Avoid pure white for body, use text-slate-300. Numbers: Always use font-mono for metrics, tracking-tighter for large numbers. Labels: Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em], text-slate-400.

colors.background: bg-[#0A0E17] (Deepest slate, not pure black. Board-grade luxury feel)

visual enhancers.cards: Remove generic flat slate cards. Use: bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/5 shadow-2xl. On hover: border-white/15 bg-slate-900/80.
visual enhancers.glows: For active or critical metrics, use subtle radial gradients. Example: absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-[domain-color]/10 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-50 pointer-events-none.
visual enhancers.charts: Wrap Recharts in <ChartBox> with deep background and a glowing subtle top border matching the domain accent. Use Recharts <Area> with fillOpacity={0.1} and a gradient definition.
visual enhancers.lines: Use sharp 1px borders to separate grid items instead of padding gaps to increase density (border-r border-b border-white/5).

component name.tables: Dense. Header text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 border-b border-white/10. Rows hover state: hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors. Status badges inside cells.
component name.metrics: Large value text-5xl font-head tracking-tighter. Label text-xs font-mono uppercase text-slate-400. Trend indicator text-sm flex items-center gap-1.
component name.empty_states: For 'Connect integration' or missing live data, use a dashed border border-dashed border-white/20, a muted icon text-slate-600, and a small primary CTA button.

grids.system: 12-col grid for everything. gap-4 or gap-6 for tight enterprise density.
grids.symmetric_cards: Standardize card heights using h-full and flex-col. Use col-span-3, col-span-4, col-span-6 symmetrically to prevent jagged bottoms.

layouts.density: Screen-filling. No dead space. Dashboards must stretch horizontally to fill the viewport, utilizing every pixel. F-pattern priority.
layouts.compliance_matrix: Must be a dense, scrollable table. max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto overflow-x-auto relative. Freeze the first column (Framework/Control) and header row using sticky top-0 z-10 bg-[#0A0E17] and sticky left-0 z-20 bg-[#0A0E17]. Use tight padding px-3 py-2 text-sm.

motion.hover_states: Every interactive element must have transition-colors duration-200. Interactive Cards should have hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.12)].

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds must exceed WCAG AA. Do not use pure black bg, and do not use dark grey text on dark backgrounds. Use text-slate-300 for readable body, text-white for emphasis.
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none.

media.icons: Use lucide-react with thin stroke widths (strokeWidth={1.5}) to match the board-grade premium aesthetic.

3d libraries and steps.charts: No 3D needed for standard dashboard charts, use Recharts natively, but style them beautifully. DO NOT use ResponsiveContainer, allow ChartBox to manage height.
3d libraries and steps.data_viz_recharts: Areas: Use <defs> to create linear gradients for <Area> charts. Grids: Use <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray='3 3' stroke='rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' vertical={false} />. Tooltips: bg-[#0A0E17]/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 p-3 rounded-lg shadow-xl text-sm font-mono. For FAIR Monte-Carlo bands, use multi-layered Area charts with decreasing opacity. For LEC (Loss Exceedance Curves), use smooth LineCharts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT remove existing features, logic, or data mappings. Enhance visually only.

Apply domain-specific color tinting (bg, border, charts) based on the current page to eliminate the monotone feel (e.g., Executive is Blue, Compliance is Green, Financials is Cyan, AI Governance is Rose, Asset Intel is Amber).
Implement the Compliance Posture matrix using a dense HTML table with sticky headers/first-column to allow viewing all frameworks without page dead-space.
Add 'connect integration' empty states elegantly where live data is required but missing, using dashed borders and low-opacity icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the monotone slate by injecting the domain-specific subtle background tints (`bg-{color}-950/10`) and border glows. Do not use centered alignments for metrics; align left for readability. Use modern pill-shaped or sharp interactions. Every interactive element needs hover states. Add `data-testid` to everything. DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays. Make sure to use Recharts properly with <ChartBox> and avoid ResponsiveContainer. Apply these guidelines for .js files in the React stack.
